outsiders.hook: ComfyUI tooling news (Minimax-H3 with native LLM text encoders, no LoRA training) as a tight bullet post: 2,914 views, 64 bookmarks - more saves than likes.
outsiders.video_tip: Screen-record your node graph for 10s, then show the output it produced; overlay the two settings that mattered.

No gradient training, no LoRA. Minimax-H3 Text Encoders PK lets modern LLM and VLM text encoders, native to ComfyUI, act as the conditioning encoder - pick Gemma 4, Qwen 3.8 27B, or the Qwen 3.5 family in 0.8B, 2B, 4B and 9B sizes.

Works across T2VA, Image-to-Video, FL2VA and Ref2VA video pipelines. Link in the original post.

narrative_synthesis: Outsider AI posts from the last ~48 hours were dominated by one copy-paste wave and one sponsored push. The biggest numbers came from a caption template - 'This AI animation is absolutely amazing' or 'better than Disney' plus 'Seedance 2.5' over an anime-style clip - that ran on several accounts within minutes of each other; lexx_aura's version hit 173,696 views and 1,555 bookmarks, PiSForever44's 31,393 from 1.4K followers, with more copies on 26-27.11. Treat that as a template wave, not proof of an organic trend. Second, MAGI-2 on Higgsfield kept going: paid-partnership tests repeat the $0.08/sec, 30s 1080p spec (ChillaiKalan__ 29,901), while Higgsfield's own demos moved to craft angles - a short lit by one candle, Blender previs against final shots, and sketch keyframes to animation (8.7K-9.6K each). Side currents: ComfyUI tooling news and stack lists earned more saves than likes, a post speculating that Grok Imagine is being deprioritized, creators naming continuity (new face on every reroll) as the bar for AI filmmaking, and Thanksgiving-timed content like a live 30-second turkey short. On the watchlist, a quiet holiday: andresvandal's one-line dark-fairytale logline over video was the only hit. For Bogdan: a 40K or sci-fi micro-short with a one-sentence ominous logline, or a continuity test across three angles, fits what is landing.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
